app.title: EzyOCR
about.description: Reads barcodes and text from the camera, extracts the fields defined by the business script, sends the results to ezyplatform and prints labels on demand.
about.platform_note: Station page, sign-in and data sync
about.plugin_note: Business scripts, image uploads and station management

camera.require_barcode: Only recognize when a barcode is visible
camera.station_hint: This is the camera of the running shift. Results shown here are also sent to the work page as usual. "Capture now" applies to the shift immediately. Closing this window does not affect the shift.
camera.test_hint: Place a label in front of the camera and hold it still for about half a second to recognize it automatically. A "ding" means both the tracking number and the customer code were read; a low tone means one of them is missing. Click "Capture now" to recognize the current frame at any time. Test mode does not put results into the server send queue.
camera.banner_not_configured: The station has not been set up. Go to menu Station → Station settings… to log in to ezyplatform.
camera.banner_not_running: The camera only turns on while there is an ezyplatform login session on the work page. If you are logged in and still see this message, reload the page or send the log files (menu Station → Open log folder).
camera.banner_camera_error: Cannot open the camera. Check the camera cable and the app's camera permission in System Settings → Privacy & Security → Camera.
error.login_required: Log in to ezyplatform before saving the settings
